THE DIRECTION PUBLISHED IN THE EXTRAORDINARY GAZETTE No. 1681/3 DATED
22ND NOVEMBER 2010
Declaring the Gampola Ambuluwawa D.M. Jayarathna Biological Diversity Complex and the
Religious Centre as a Sacred Area

ACCORDING to the communication made by His Excellency the President of the Sri Lanka Democratic Socialist Republic inthe Sri Lanka Democratic Socialist Republic Extraordinary Gazette No. 1681/3 dated 22nd Monday November 2010, andaccording to the subject of planning and developing the sacred places empowered, I Dr. Disanayaka MudiyanselageJayarathna declare that the land area definitely described in the schedule herein is a sacred area forever and declare that as‘Gampola Ambuluwawa D.M. Jayarathna Biological Diversity Complex and Sacred Religious Centre’.
DR. D.M. JAYARATHNA,Minister of Buddasasana and Religious Affairs.Ministry of Buddasasana and Religious Affairs,No. 135, Anagarika Dharmapala Mawatha,Colombo 07.18thNovember, 2014.
